source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 7–11 and 12:1–31 align directly; public 12:32 binds Hebrew 13:1. All 161 original XML records are hashed in full, including the numbering note.

key_decisions.decision: Supplies the implied speaking contrast to make the elliptical sentence understandable while retaining the generation distinction.
Preserves the named ancestry, earth-mouth image, and full list of swallowed dependents; notes the final expression's range.
Retains the unusual foot-irrigation expression and explains its uncertain mechanism in a note rather than substituting hand.
Uses quotation to mark the divine promise that follows while retaining the source's first- and third-person divine references.
Preserves I will rather than silently changing it to he will and makes the two agricultural rain seasons clear.
Preserves the causal sequence of anger, closed heavens, crop failure, and perishing.
Retains every geographical marker and the rhetorical question while noting the compressed route description's uncertainty.
